name: TrustRAG Claims
description: A hand-labelled, claim-level benchmark of 37 questions and 109 claims for evaluating hallucination detection in retrieval-augmented generation.

schema.question: The question the claims answer.
schema.relevant_sources: Source document filenames that contain the supporting evidence.
schema.claim_id: Claim identifier within a question, for example Q01-C1.
schema.hallucinated: true if the claim is not supported by the source, false if it is.
